newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 569,500 MT were one-third below the week earlier and two-fifths under the 4-week average.

Major increases reported for Japan (218,200 MT, reflects 233,800 new sales, 15,600 cancellations), Taiwan (172,900 MT, reflects 163,400 new sales, 56,000 destination changes, 46,500 cancellations), South Korea (72,400 MT, reflects 19,900 new sales, 52,500 destination changes), Spain (60,600 MT), and Mexico (42,000 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (59,000 MT) and Colombia (17,000 MT).

Exports of 1,036,900 MT were 5 percent more than the previous week and 2 percent more than the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (295,100 MT), Spain (238,400 MT), Taiwan (172,400 MT), Portugal (98,400 MT), and South Korea (55,100 MT).
